model: Popover, dropdown, select, and tooltip panels faded, scaled from 0.95, and slid 0.5rem. animate-in is 150ms. Those enter and exit animations are gone. The menus still open in place.

noise.rule: 9 is round(150ms * 60 / 1000). Open and close each pay that duration. One menu is open at a time. Not a sampled compositor trace.
